nodes.name: Notify Finance Team
nodes.notes:
Connect to Slack, Email, or SMS node to notify finance team of flagged expenses.

Recommended integrations:
- Slack: Post to #finance-alerts channel
- Email: Send to finance@agentloop.co.za
- SMS: Critical high-value expenses (>R50k)

nodes.name: Export to Xero (Optional)
nodes.notes:
Optional: Export categorized expense to Xero/QuickBooks.
Requires OAuth2 credentials configured.

Enable by connecting from 'Process Duplicate Check' node.
